caption_hr: Usporedite tri mjesečne arhivske stope: sve prihvatljive izvore, objedinjeni stalni skup od 128 izvora i isti skup s ponderom 1/128 za svaku domenu. Nedostupan ili nulti nazivnik bilo kojeg člana znači nedostupnu stopu sa stalnim ponderima. Granica u siječnju 2024. ostaje; stalni ponderi ne uklanjaju promjene prikupljanja.
caption_en: Compare three monthly archive rates: all eligible sources, the pooled frozen 128-source panel, and that panel with each domain weighted 1/128. A missing or zero panel denominator makes the fixed-weight rate unavailable. The January 2024 boundary remains; fixed weights do not repair capture changes.
limitation: Descriptive archive; January 2024 collection boundary; no independent validation

caption_hr: Efektivni broj domena koje doprinose iznosi 38,4; deset najvećih donosi 42,0% objava. Izračun obuhvaća svih 281 domena s objavama o HNB-u. Mjeri koncentraciju domena, a ne vlasništva ili raznolikosti stavova.
caption_en: The effective number of contributing domains is 38.4; the ten largest supply 42.0% of publications. All 281 contributing domains enter this calculation. It measures domain concentration, not ownership or viewpoint diversity.
limitation: Descriptive archive; January 2024 collection boundary; no independent validation

selection: 2021-01/2026-08; all eligible sources or declared frozen panel
caption_hr: U cijelom razdoblju 281 od 416 opaženih pozadinskih domena objavljuje o HNB-u (67,5%). Godišnje vrijednosti koriste uniju domena; zbrajanje mjesečnih brojeva ne daje godišnji obuhvat.
caption_en: 281 of 416 observed background domains carry HNB publications in the full window (67.5%). Annual values use unions of domains; monthly counts cannot be added to obtain annual breadth.

selection: 2021-01/2026-08; all eligible sources or declared frozen panel
caption_hr: 5.222 od 33.235 objava navodi HNB u naslovu (15,7%). Godišnji udjeli dijele godišnji broj podudarnih naslova godišnjim brojem objava. Podudaranje je mehaničko obilježje, a ne validirana istaknutost ni dokaz trenda.
caption_en: 5,222 of 33,235 publications name HNB in the title (15.7%). Annual shares divide annual title matches by annual publications. A title match is mechanical evidence, not validated prominence or proof of a trend.
limitation: Descriptive archive; January 2024 collection boundary; no independent validation
